def solve(case):
    # Validate case
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be a dict")
    tokens = case.get("tokens")
    calls = case.get("calls")
    if not isinstance(tokens, list) or not all(isinstance(t, str) for t in tokens):
        raise ValueError("tokens must be list of strings")
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls must be list")
    for call in calls:
        if not isinstance(call, dict):
            raise ValueError("each call must be a dict")
        for key in ("call_id", "start", "end", "score", "replacement_tokens"):
            if key not in call:
                raise ValueError(f"call missing {key}")
        if not isinstance(call["call_id"], str):
            raise ValueError("call_id must be string")
        if not isinstance(call["start"], int) or not isinstance(call["end"], int):
            raise ValueError("start and end must be int")
        if call["start"] < 0 or call["start"] > len(tokens) or call["end"] < 0 or call["end"] > len(tokens):
            raise ValueError("start or end out of bounds")
        if call["start"] >= call["end"]:
            raise ValueError("start must be less than end")
        if not isinstance(call["score"], (int, float)):
            raise ValueError("score must be number")
        if not isinstance(call["replacement_tokens"], list) or not all(isinstance(r, str) for r in call["replacement_tokens"]):
            raise ValueError("replacement_tokens must be list of strings")
    # Sort by descending score, then ascending start, then call_id
    sorted_calls = sorted(calls, key=lambda c: (-c["score"], c["start"], c["call_id"]))
    selected = []  # will store dicts or tuples with start, end, call_id, replacement_tokens
    intervals = []  # list of (start, end)
    for call in sorted_calls:
        s, e = call["start"], call["end"]
        overlap = False
        for (other_s, other_e) in intervals:
            if not (e <= other_s or s >= other_e):
                overlap = True
                break
        if not overlap:
            selected.append(call)
            intervals.append((s, e))
    # Order selected by start ascending
    selected_sorted = sorted(selected, key=lambda c: (c["start"], c["call_id"]))
    selected_call_ids = [c["call_id"] for c in selected_sorted]
    # Apply replacements from right to left
    result_tokens = list(tokens)
    # Sort selected by start descending
    for call in sorted(selected, key=lambda c: -c["start"]):
        s, e = call["start"], call["end"]
        repl = call["replacement_tokens"]
        result_tokens[s:e] = repl
    return {"selected_call_ids": selected_call_ids, "tokens": result_tokens}
